scope: Retained 16 families / 19 Roman or Italic files; ASCII Western digits only.
method: Original font bytes unchanged. wght=400; all other VF axes use original defaults. GSUB/GPOS tags are inventory; requested settings are actually shaped with HarfBuzz. Outline deltas compare glyph drawings, separately from ID, advance and offset deltas.

semantics.offsets: null means all glyph offsets are [0,0]; otherwise [x,y] per input digit.
semantics.ink_bounds: Per-digit [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], relative to that glyph pen origin including shaped offset; y grows upward, units are font units.
semantics.advances: Advance in the shaped input run, including actual OpenType positioning. Equal advances do not imply equal ink widths or figure heights.
semantics.required_explicit_tags_absent: Explicit combination not tested because named enabling tag is absent. Default may already have that form; inspect other measured settings.

non_claims: This measures font-specific behavior, not personal preference or calendar readability.
Common digits use a deliberate Latn/en context; no claim for all languages, scripts, font versions or user-selected axes.
A requested feature may legitimately produce no visible change because the default already matches it.
Oldstyle/lining form is not inferred solely from baseline bounds.
